MilO collects your phone's location to record the route and distance of each trip, including the trips that start by themselves when the phone connects to your vehicle, even when the app is closed or not in use.

Your location stays on this phone. MilO has no account and no server, and shares it with no one. To show where a trip started and ended, MilO hands those two positions to your phone's own address lookup, which on most phones is Google's.

On the next screen, choose "Allow all the time".
The trip notification, and the warning when a trip could not start, need this.
Without it MilO cannot see the truck connect or disconnect.
Location is switched off for the whole phone. No trip can be recorded.
Android may stop MilO to save battery. In the list that opens, show all apps, choose MilO, then "Don't optimise".
Recommended. Switch off \"Pause app activity if unused\" for MilO, or Android stops it after months without being opened.
Battery Saver is on. It limits location and background work, so a trip can be missed or cut short.
Recommended. The driving alert needs this: it is how the phone tells MilO that you are driving. MilO only sends a notification then, and never starts a trip by itself.
MilO cannot read this setting. On MilO\'s app page, set Battery saver to \"No restrictions\", then confirm it here.

Recommended. MilO cannot read these. Under \"Other permissions\", switch on \"Show on Lock screen\", the permission to start or open windows in the background, and \"Permanent notification\". Then confirm it here.
MilO cannot read this. Open the recent apps, press and hold MilO\'s card and tap the padlock, so the cleaners leave MilO alone. Then confirm it here.
Not needed: the driving alert is switched off in Settings.
Allow precise location first, in the row above.
Battery use for MilO is set to Restricted, which blocks trip recording. Change it to Unrestricted on MilO\'s app page.
Android reports that MilO is restricted in the background, which blocks trip recording. On MilO\'s app page, open Battery saver and choose \"No restrictions\".

MilO stops watching for it, and it no longer starts a trip. Its trips stay as they are. You can pair it again at any time.

Makes a text file of every line, oldest first, and offers it to your apps, so that you can send it to whoever is helping you. The file names the truck and the phone\'s other paired devices, and holds every address you typed or replaced on the edit screen.

The trip ends where and when the truck stopped, even if Bluetooth stays connected. A new trip starts when the truck moves again.
A shorter trip is discarded, such as moving the truck around the yard. A discarded trip can still be counted on the Trips screen.
Tell me when I drive without a trip

During your work hours, if the phone notices that you are driving while no trip is being recorded and the truck is not connected, MilO sends a notification. Tap it to start a trip. MilO never starts one from this by itself: the phone cannot tell the truck from any other vehicle.
It needs the Physical activity permission, which the Setup screen asks for. The phone can take a minute or more to notice that you are driving.
A notification once a day, from the day set above until the report for last month is recorded as sent. Tap it to open that report. A month without a Business trip brings no reminder.
Start on this day of the month
In a month that has fewer days, the reminder starts on its last day.
Plays when MilO connects to the truck and a trip begins, or when Start is pressed.
Plays once a trip is under way: the first time MilO sees the truck moving at driving speed. Also when a parked truck drives off.

Android backs MilO up by itself, to your Google account and when you move to a new phone, if backup is switched on in the phone\'s own settings: the trips, the sent reports, the settings and the event log. The event log names the truck and the other paired devices, with their Bluetooth addresses, and holds addresses you typed. The GPS points are moved from phone to phone only, never to the cloud. After a restore the truck has to be paired again, and Setup gone through again.
An export is your own copy of everything, in one file, kept where you choose. It needs neither Google nor this phone.
Last export: %1$s at %2$s, without the GPS points
No export has been made on this phone yet.

Every position MilO recorded along every trip. They make the file many times larger. The trips are complete without them. Switched off, the file still says where each trip started and ended, as an address and as a position, with its times and its distance.
An import replaces everything on this phone with what is in an export file. MilO reads the whole file first, and asks before it changes anything.
Before an import MilO kept a copy of what this phone held then, on %1$s at %2$s.
A trip is being recorded. Export and import wait until it has ended.
Replacing the data on this phone. This can take a minute…
Exported: %1$s and %2$s, without the GPS points.

Left out of the file: %1$s that are stored for no trip this phone holds. The Log screen says which.
Imported: %1$s and %2$s. The file holds no GPS points, so the imported trips have none.
Imported: %1$s and %2$s. The GPS points in the file could not be stored. The trips are complete without them. Import the same file again to try once more. The Log screen says why.
The file holds no settings, so the settings of this phone were kept.
The settings in the file could not be stored, so the settings of this phone are still in force. The Log screen says why.
The truck has to be paired again on this phone before a trip can start by itself. Use the button of the Truck card, at the top of this screen.
What this phone held before is kept inside MilO. \"Put that data back\" undoes the import.
MilO was closed in the middle of the last import. It finished the import when it started again.
MilO was closed just as the last import began, before anything was replaced. Everything on this phone is as it was. Import the file again.

MilO was closed in the middle of the last import. The trips and the sent reports are the file\'s. Its GPS points are not stored, and its settings may not be either. Import the same file again to make it whole. The Log screen says more.

MilO was closed in the middle of the last import and could not finish it afterwards. The trips and the sent reports are the file\'s, and GPS points of the trips before it may still be stored with them. Import the same file again. The Log screen says why.
A trip is being recorded, so nothing was done. Try again when it has ended.

That file is not an export of MilO\'s. Nothing was changed.
That file was written by a newer MilO (export format %1$d). This MilO reads export formats up to %2$d. Update MilO on this phone, then import the file again. Nothing was changed.
That file is damaged or incomplete, so it was not imported. Nothing was changed. The Log screen says what is wrong with it.
There is no copy to put back.

This is the copy MilO kept before an import, on %1$s at %2$s. It holds %3$s, %4$s and %5$s.
Importing REPLACES everything on this phone: its %1$s and %2$s go, with all their GPS points, and the file\'s take their place. Nothing is merged.
The settings are replaced by the file\'s as well. A truck that is paired on this phone stays paired; otherwise the truck has to be paired again afterwards.
The file holds no settings: the settings of this phone stay.
MilO first keeps a copy of what this phone holds now, so that the import can be undone. The event log is not replaced.
MilO first keeps a copy of what this phone holds now, so that this can be undone as well. The copy that is put back is then removed, because the phone holds it again. The event log is not replaced.

Your name, company and vehicle are printed at the top of the mileage report. A report cannot be made without your name, or sent without the accountant\'s address. Company and vehicle can be left empty. Each is saved as you type.
The vehicle as accounts know it, such as its make, model and plate.
MilO never sends anything itself. It opens your email app with the report attached and this address filled in, and you press send.
Not saved: this is not a complete email address. It has to look like name@example.com, with nothing else in the field.

A trip that starts on a tracked day, between that day\'s start and end, is saved as Business. Any other trip is Personal. A trip that is still running at the end time is recorded to its end and marked \"ran past schedule\".
A change applies to trips that end after it. Trips already saved keep what they are; you can change any of them on the Trips screen.
Use these hours on every tracked day

They are listed on the Trips screen and added up apart from Business.
